texts.en:
We can expand our borders by [GetBuildingGrowing] Starbases around alien stars. This secures the £system£ System, grants resource access, and blocks passage for contacts if borders are closed.

Select a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship, then click the [GetBuildGrowCap] Starbase button in its fleet interface and left-click a star. Alternatively, right-click the star and select [GetBuildGrowCap] Starbase.

Unlike other orbital stations, Starbases can be built outside of our borders.
